summary: Implement a small stateless Node.js 22 HTTP health service using only built-in http and node:test. It exports a server factory (Application) separate from an executable startup entry (Startup). GET /health returns 200 JSON {"status":"ok"}, unknown routes return 404 JSON error, and the service keeps answering /health afterward. npm start listens on process.env.PORT (default 3000); npm test runs real HTTP tests on an ephemeral loopback port; npm run build syntax-checks all source. CommonJS .cjs conventions throughout.

tasks.description: Implement the exported HTTP server factory in src/app.cjs. It builds a Node http.Server from an injected request handler. GET /health returns 200 with JSON {"status":"ok"}; all other routes return 404 with a JSON error body. Handler is stateless so /health stays correct after any unknown request.

contracts.description: createServer() returns an http.Server using the health/404 handler; no listening occurs in the factory.
GET /health -> 200 application/json body {"status":"ok"}; any other route -> 404 JSON error.

tasks.description: Implement the executable startup entry in src/server.cjs. It imports the factory, parses process.env.PORT with default 3000, listens on that port and logs readiness. It must not be executed when tests import the factory.

contracts.description: Startup entry listens on process.env.PORT, defaulting to 3000.

tasks.description: Write package.json with start (node src/server.cjs), test (node --test), and build (syntax-check script). No third-party dependencies; CommonJS .cjs modules.

contracts.description: npm test runs node:test; npm run build syntax-checks all source JavaScript.
scripts/check-syntax.cjs uses node --check on each source .cjs file; derived from NFR2 with no external linter dependency.

tasks.description: Write real HTTP tests. test/health.test.cjs uses node:test and the factory, listening on an ephemeral loopback port (port 0), asserting health 200 body, unknown-route 404 body, then health again, and closing the server via after(). test/startup.test.cjs verifies the factory returns a non-listening server, that 'npm start' entry (src/server.cjs) listens on process.env.PORT and answers /health, and that the check-syntax build script exits 0 (covering FR3 and NFR2).

contracts.description: Tests use a real listening server on loopback port 0, check health/unknown/health ordering, and close the server.

tasks.description: Write README.md with install/start/test instructions and a source-to-requirement mapping (FR1-3, NFR1-2).

contracts.description: README documents install, start, test and a small source-to-requirement mapping.

assumptions: The syntax-check build step uses node --check rather than a third-party linter, since the design forbids third-party packages.
The exported factory is named createServer and lives in src/app.cjs; the exact symbol name is not specified in the source and is a derived interface.
The 404 JSON error body shape (e.g. {"error":"Not Found"}) is not dictated verbatim; any JSON error body is acceptable per FR2.
Only the two listed documents are requirements; no Compose, gateway, database, Dockerfile, or OpenAPI is required.
